stories.title: Cell biochemistry beyond membranes: Condensate physics reveals general rules for chemical responses
stories.desc: Basic biology courses teach that cells contain organelles—such as the nucleus, mitochondria and Golgi apparatus—set apart by lipid membranes to get things done. Recent cell biology research has revealed another organizational principle at work in cells across all orders of biology.
